name.text: 同一句话换成肯定、否定和不同问法
One Idea Across Polarity and Question Types

description.text: 同一个意思，对照肯定与否定，以及陈述、一般疑问和特殊疑问。
Same idea across affirmative and negative, and across statement, yes-no, and wh-questions.
用于比较同一个意思说成肯定或否定时的差异。
Used to compare how the same idea changes between affirmative and negative forms.

name.text: 同一意思怎样陈述或发问
Statement vs Question Forms for One Idea

description.text: 用于比较同一个意思说成一般陈述、一般疑问或特殊疑问时的差异。
Used to compare how the same idea changes across declarative, yes-no, and wh-question forms.
谓语前的否定操作。don't / didn't / won't / can't / mustn't 等都走这一格，合起来才是否定谓语的完整操作（后面跟原形）。例如 We do not need two liters of water today.

Negative operator before the verb. don't / didn't / won't / can't / mustn't and related forms sit in one hole because together they are the predicate’s full negative operator. Example: We do not need two liters of water today.

categoryDescription.text: 用于直接承载否定完整式、缩写与允许的否定 clitic。
Directly carries full negative forms, contractions, and allowed negative clitics.

description.text: 构成疑问、否定，或给一般动词提供时态。可以是 do / does / did。常见写法如 do、does、did。例如 Which one do you want?
Builds questions, negatives, or tense support: do / does / did. Common writings include do, does, did. Example: Which one do you want?

categoryDescription.text: 用于控制 be、do、have、存在式或附加问句中的助动形式。
Controls auxiliary forms for be, do, have, existential frames, or tag questions.

description.text: 疑问句里的否定词 not。常见写法如 not。例如 Do they not play basketball in winter?
The word not in a negative question. Common writings include not. Example: Do they not play basketball in winter?

categoryDescription.text: 用于直接承载否定完整式、缩写与允许的否定 clitic。
Directly carries full negative forms, contractions, and allowed negative clitics.

description.text: 用来讲一般会做、习惯做或将要做的动作，不强调“正在进行中”。
For habitual, general, or future actions — not the sense of “in progress right now”.

name.text: 用 do/does/did 确认平时会不会做某事
Asking Yes/No with Do / Does / Did

description.text: 确认平时会不会做某事。
Used to ask about whether someone usually does something.
用来询问为什么做某事。常见于提问场景。
Used to Asking Why Someone Does Something.
